verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's GitHub README lists "Automatic retry with proxy chain and fallback fetch function", which directly names automatic retry across a proxy chain, backed by general proxy support and anti-bot features (undetected browser, stealth modes). The evidence is a single one-line feature mention: it does not document that retries are triggered by anti-bot block detection, how the chain is configured, or how well it works. missing for 10: documented anti-bot block detection as the retry trigger, configuration docs for the proxy chain and rotation behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically retry through a chain of different proxies when anti-bot detection blocks a request
